_comment: Sanitized machine-readable contract for the SBSEG click channel, verified against legacy production behavior on 2026-08-20. It contains field shapes and non-identifying examples; visitor and session data is excluded.
reconciledWith: 2026-08-26: validated against 161 customer-provided payloads; confirmed the event-name rule and all per-click, shared, and consent buckets; added pseudonym_id plus conditional link_href and link_href_domain fields.

endpoint.note: Intuit first-party Segment proxy; /v2/segment/<source>/{t,p,i}=track/page/identify; source=intuit-general-clickstream. NOT sendBeacon, NOT an image pixel.

sendLayer.injectedVia: intuit/ies-erp/prod Tealium profile (tags.tiqcdn.com/utag/intuit/ies-erp/prod/utag.js) — the SAME profile plugins/tealium-martech loads
sendLayer.behavior: One delegated click listener on document. On click, walks up from the target: GATE = data-object OR data-wa-link within 5 ancestors (else silent no-op). Applies defaults, expands custom-properties to top-level props, computes the ui_access_point trail, attaches the ~47 shared context + consent, posts the batched content:<action> beacon. Reads DYNAMICALLY-INJECTED data-* too (verified).
sendLayer.siteIntegration: The site derives each CTA's identity and stamps data-* at pointerdown or click capture, before the injected tracker's handler reads those attributes. Shared context, consent, sending, and batching remain the injected tracker's responsibility.

envelope.eventNameRule: event = `${object}:${action}` (content:engaged, content:interacted, video:started, video:engaged, ...). NOT a constant.

perClickFields._note: Fields the site derives for each click. The contract tests compare these fields plus the event name. Presence varies by element type.

always.action: data-action; DEFAULT 'engaged' when absent. Varies by intent: nav->engaged, generic CTA->interacted, video-play->started, video-link->engaged
always.personalization_details: ARRAY; [] unless the element is in a pzn placement (appVars.pznPageRecDetailsArr overrides DOM data-pzn-*)

conditional.ui_access_point: when data-ui-access-point KEY is present (opt-in; empty '' counts). VALUE = computed data-tracking trail broad->specific, hyphens->underscores, sacrificial-anchor skipped, fallback 'page'. Authored value does NOT verbatim-win (tracker-replica.mjs is WRONG on this).
conditional.link_name: when authored via data-custom-properties (expanded to top-level)
conditional.link_href: when the element is an out-navigating link/button with a resolved destination; the target URL (observed on content:goto and nav-out events)
conditional.link_href_domain: when link_href present; its host (e.g. erp.intuit.com)
conditional.<any-custom-prop>: EVERY k|v in data-custom-properties is expanded to a TOP-LEVEL property. There is NO custom_properties object in the payload.

sharedContext._note: Keys the injected tracker attaches to every page-view and click event. The site does not derive these, so they are outside the per-click contract comparison.

consentFields._note: Added to every event by the injected tracker through OneTrust. These are shared fields rather than site-derived per-click fields.

examples._label: CONTROLLED full-path content (dynamically-injected; exact input->output ground truth)
CONTROLLED wa-link-only (no data-object; proves defaults content/engaged/link — replica's walink/INTERACTED is outdated)
REAL outcomes-carousel dot (object=content, custom-props link_name, trail->page)
REAL video 'Watch product demo' (object=video, action=engaged -> event video:engaged)
